dateline: DAY 4382 — OCTOBER 2026 — GOVERNMENT REPORT PRESENTED WITHOUT PARENTS, FAMILIES MARCH ON 12TH ANNIVERSARY
heroHeadline: Government Presents Ayotzinapa Report Without Parents as Families March on 12th Anniversary
heroSubtitle: Families of the 43 marched to Mexico City's Zócalo on September 26, demanding justice, the return of the GIEI and release of 800+ military folios. On September 28, Segob's Arturo Medina and special prosecutor Mauricio Pazarán presented the government's progress report with new investigative lines and phone-record analysis; President Sheinbaum said the case is not closed but that parents were not convened because there was 'nothing new' for them.
footerNote: Data compiled from GIEI reports (I–VI), Mexican Truth Commission, CNDH Recommendation 208VG/2026, EAAF forensic reports, IACHR/OHCHR statements, and investigative journalism (Proceso, Infobae, La Jornada, Tlachinollan). All contested claims are marked.
